english.note: Use 暗示 as the all-purpose noun for an indirect hint or reference.
Use this when the message is conveyed indirectly rather than stated openly.
Use this for an implied suggestion or hint that leads someone to infer an idea.

examples.english: He said the ticket was too expensive; that was actually an allusion telling us not to go.
examples.traditional: 佢話張飛太貴，呢句其實係一個暗示，叫我哋唔好去。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zoeng1 fei1 taai3 gwai3 ne1 geoi3 kei4 sat6 hai6 jat1 go3 am3 si6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 heoi3

examples.english: They keep saying they want fish balls; it is actually a hint that I should treat them.
examples.traditional: 佢成日話想食魚蛋，其實係暗示我請佢食。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 soeng2 sik6 jyu4 daan2 kei4 sat6 hai6 am3 si6 ngo5 ceng2 keoi5 sik6

examples.english: The way he said it was basically a suggestion that I should resign.
examples.traditional: 佢咁樣講，根本就係暗示我應該辭職。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 am3 si6 ngo5 jing1 goi1 ci4 zik1
